name: Weekend of Hell
blurb: Europe's horror-movie celebrity convention at the Crowne Plaza Düsseldorf-Neuss, with star autographs, photo ops and a horror dealer hall.
notes: Billed as Europe's biggest horror-themed celebrity convention, matching the seed note. The current homepage (English, last modified 2026-09-27 per the site's own sitemap, i.e. right after the event) still shows 'COMING SOON' placeholders for guests, vendors and cosplayers and no date text at all -- it appears to be unrefreshed leftover content rather than an announcement of a new edition. Multiple independent listings (happeningnext.com, rostercon.com, allevents.in, conmap.de, stayhappening.com), each citing the same Eventbrite listing linked from this homepage, agree the most recent edition ran 2026-09-26 to 2026-09-27 at Crowne Plaza Düsseldorf - Neuss -- which already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window, so it is recorded as 'last' rather than as an edition. No 2027 (or later-2026) date has been announced on the site itself, so editions is empty. Guests were not captured since no edition in the window has an announced lineup (the on-site 'coming soon' guest tiles were for the now-past Sept 2026 show); recheck closer to a 2027 announcement.
